newsitem.title: UK: AEI opens five new offices in China.
newsitem.headline: AEI opens five new offices in China.

text.p: Air Express International (AEI) has announced a dramatic expansion of its operations in China with the opening of five offices.
Seven Chinese cities are now served by AEI.
The new offices are located in Tianjin, Guangzhou (Canton), Suzhou, Pudong and Changchun. Changchun is the last of the five offices to open and it is scheduled to open in October.
All of the offices will provide air and ocean services for import and export traffic.
"The demands of our multinational customers and the sheer size of the Chinese market have compelled us to expand our operations," said Bobby Chao, AEI's general manager for Hong Kong.
Headquartered in Darien, Connecticut, U.S., AEI offers integrated logistics services on a worldwide basis. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
